rooms.name: access tunnel
rooms.description:
You are standing in what appears to be an underground service access tunnel of some kind. The overhead neon lights flicker and provide barely useful illumination. The air is damp and musty, and it feels as though nobody has gone through here in years. The tunnel runs south from here. This appears to be the north end of the tunnel. There is a large, open manhole in the floor here.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: the basement
rooms.description:
You are in the basement of the LPC University administrative building. It is very dark here, and rather damp. The fluorescent lighting seems to be on the verge of total failure, with only one or two flickering on and off enough to see anything. The air here is damp, thick and musty. There is a small crawlspace you can enter under the stairs here, and the basement continues west into darkness.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: the campus bookstore
rooms.description: This is the Virtual Campus Bookstore. It is a fairly small place, and in fact has few books available, since the campus is not open for classes yet. There is, however, a wide assortment of useful items available, which you can browse by typing the 'list' command. The storeroom is above. There is a sign on the wall behind the counter.

npcs.name: Kim, the bookstore employee
description: Kim is a twenty-something college student trying to make enough money to pay for school and feed herself. She seems friendly enough, and her bright blue eyes seem to smile at you on their own. You could probably buy something from her here, since that's her job, or she might even buy something from you, if she thinks it's worth something. Don't try to buy anything if you don't have enough money, though...she looks like she can mean business when she has to.

This is the Virtual Campus ad hoc conference room. It is elegantly appointed with richly carved mahogany paneling and gold-leaf trim. The luxurious carpeting and moody lighting make this conference room a very comfortable, relaxing environment. The main hallway is north of here.
There is a sign you can read here.

rooms.name: Conference Room
rooms.description:
This is an enchanted room, with the magical power to prevent uninvited people from entering. It is used for meetings where three or more people need to share information without interruption or privately. To enable privacy, 'privacy on'. To disable it, 'privacy off'. The privacy field automatically deactivates after approximately 20 minutes.

description: Charles is a test subject in unethical artificial intelligence experiments. If he were smart enough, he'd resent his forced servitude and lack of rights. Dangerously, his overlords are trying to make him smarter.

description: Shiny, white laboratory walls.

rooms.name: Science Building Hallway
rooms.description: This is the LPC University Science Building, where exciting new systems and abstract research happens. South of here is the probability laboratory. The hallway continues west. The building's exit is north, leading to University Square.

rooms.name: Science Building Hallway
rooms.description: This is the main hallway in the LPC University Science Building. The hallway runs east and west from here. To the south is a sliding door. North of here is the stargate laboratory.

scenery.name: door
description: A strange, metallic sliding door.

rooms.name: Science Building Hallway, West
rooms.description: This is the western end of the main hallway in the LPC University Science Building. The main hallway runs east from here, toward the building's exit. Another hallway runs south from here.

rooms.name: hallway bend
rooms.description: This is a bend in the hallway. The main Science Building hallway is north of here. A smaller hallway runs west from here.

rooms.name: Secondary Science Hallway East
rooms.description: This is the secondary hallway in the LPC University Science Building. The hallway runs east and west from here. To the south is a sliding door. North of here is a classroom.

scenery.name: door
description: A strange, metallic sliding door.

rooms.name: Secondary Science Hallway West
rooms.description: This is the secondary hallway in the LPC University Science Building. The hallway runs east from here. To the north is a sliding door. To the west is an elevator door.

scenery.name: door
description: A strange, metallic sliding door.

rooms.name: Science building, second floor
rooms.description: This is the second floor of the LPC University Science Building. To the west is an elevator door.

rooms.name: sewer
rooms.description:
You are in the stinking underground tunnels of a sewer system. The air here is quite foul, and periodic blasts of steam from wall-mounted vents make it very hot and very humid. There is a foot-high stream of dark liquid covering the bottom of this tunnel, running east to west along the tunnel's length. The tunnel narrows dramatically here, and becomes so small that further movement west is not possible.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: tunnel
description: Here the tunnel becomes so narrow that you can't go any further west. It looks like some debris has accumulated here over time, almost clogging the waste flow.

scenery.name: sewer
description: Though evidently in good repair and of modern construction, this is still a sewer tunnel, and it's hostile to human comfort.

scenery.name: steam
description: Apparently there is industrial machinery nearby that exhausts hot steam through vents in the walls.

scenery.name: air
description: It is rank with the reek of decomposing waste.

scenery.name: wall
description: The walls of the sewer tunnel are made of concrete and appear well-built and sturdy.

scenery.name: stream
description: Whatever this stuff is, water is not its main component. It's some kind of foul-smelling liquid waste, flowing along the bottom of the tunnel.

scenery.name: sewage
description: It appears that the fluid on the bottom of this tunnel is the result of garbage and waste processing. In liquid form, this garbage flows in here from the east.

rooms.description: This is a narrow area that allows travel between the surface above and the sewer below. It's cramped, dirty, and not a friendly place for most humanoids. Some light seems to be coming in from a drainage grate above.

scenery.name: tube
description: You are in a service tube. It's foul, dark, and hot.

rooms.name: Science Building Stargate Lab
rooms.description:
This large room is the testing ground for the newly discovered stargate technology that allows for instant teleportation between distant locations. The main Science Building hallway is south.
An instruction sign is here.

npcs.name: Dr. Kleiner
description: An old, white-haired scientist, Dr. Isaac Kleiner is a beloved campus personality with his affable, kind nature and genius for exotechnology.

scenery.name: sign
description: A sign you can read. It appears to be instructions for operating the stargate.

rooms.name: The Campus Snack Bar
rooms.description: You are in a small, linoleum-tiled room lit by bright fluorescent lights. There are a few uncomfortable-looking chairs around two tables, and a sort of bar set into the north wall, behind which a food service employee stands. There is a menu hanging on the wall next to the bar. The main hallway lies south of here.

npcs.name: Gloria, the lunch lady
description: Gloria is a short, tired-looking woman getting along in her years. She doesn't seem very happy...in fact, she looks downright grumpy. Maybe if you ask her, she'll sell you something on the menu. Then again, maybe not.
npcs.room_description: Gloria, the lunch lady is here.

scenery.name: menu
description: A menu of snack items available here.

scenery.name: sign
description: A sign over the snack bar.

scenery.name: tile
description: These are here because you are not trusted to keep food off of carpets.

scenery.name: chair
description: Token furniture, not very functional or comfortable-looking. You aren't really expected to hang around in here, apparently.

scenery.name: bar
description: Really a window set into the wall and connecting the snack bar to the adjoining kitchen.

scenery.name: wall
description: The walls are painted blue and white, the school's colors. It's fairly unattractive and institutional.

scenery.name: hallway
description: The administration building's main hallway lies south.

scenery.name: light
description: Cheap, standard lighting. Like all fluorescents, these lights give everything an unappealing, sickly look.

scenery.name: employee
description: An underpaid, unappreciated, and resentful state employee. No surprise there.

rooms.name: stairwell
rooms.description: You are standing on a stairwell landing. Flights of stairs lead up and down, although the stairs up are roped off to prevent passage. The flickering fluorescent lights make it difficult to see what lies below here. There is a sign tied to the rope on the flight of stairs going up.

scenery.name: stairs
description: The stairs are made of concrete, appear to be part of the foundation of the building, and seem quite sturdy.

scenery.name: landing
description: This is a landing between flights of stairs leading up and down.

scenery.name: rope
description: Thick yellow construction rope. There's a lot of it tied to the flight of stairs leading up, preventing your passage. There's a sign hanging on it.

scenery.name: light
description: Cheap lighting that doesn't seem to work very well. Occasionally the landing is lit orange, then white again by the flickering lights.

scenery.name: sign
description: This is a handwritten, cardboard sign hanging on the roped-off stairs.

rooms.name: Science Building Stairwell, First floor
rooms.description: This is the first floor stairwell of the University Science Building.

rooms.name: Science Building Stairwell
rooms.description: This is the stairwell of the University Science Building.

rooms.name: Science Building Stairwell, bottom
rooms.description: This is the bottom of the stairwell of the university Science building. The stairs go up from here. There is a crawlspace here under the stairs. The sub basement is north.

scenery.name: stairs
description: Steps which lead up.

scenery.name: crawlspace
description: A crawlspace under the stairs.

rooms.name: LPC University Reception
rooms.description:
You are in the small, spare reception area of the Virtual Campus admissions office. A door leads north to the main administration building corridor.
A stairway up returns to the Royal Oak medical room.

npcs.name: a polite young woman
description: On closer inspection, this attractive young lady is no lady at all...she's an android! She appears to be totally motionless and frozen in place, with a friendly smile. Perhaps you can make her do something by typing: activate bot
npcs.room_description: A polite young woman is here.

rooms.name: sub basement
rooms.description: This is a basement deep under the campus. The basement continues west from here. There is a doorway to the east.

rooms.name: sub basement
rooms.description: This is a basement deep under the campus. An elevator is west, and a stairwell is south. The basement continues east.

rooms.name: Tunnel
rooms.description:
You are in a dark and narrow underground tunnel. The walls are bare rock and dirt...as if the tunnel has been carved out of and into the earth. Pipes and cables run along the southern wall, and seem to emit a low hum. To the east you see a false wall leading into the basement of the Vitual Campus administrative building. To the west, the tunnel continues into darkness.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: tunnel
description: This is evidently a hidden tunnel beneath the Virtual Campus. It's extremely creepy and dark in here.

scenery.name: walls
description: The walls are bare earth and rocks. It looks as though whoever built this tunnel was in a big hurry to get it done.

scenery.name: wall
description: The south wall is heavily laden with thick cables and metal pipes running west along its length.

scenery.name: rock
description: The walls are composed of this stuff...it's a rough excavation.

scenery.name: pipe
description: These thick pipes and cables appear to carry power somewhere along the wall. They are humming slightly.

scenery.name: darkness
description: It's deep. It's dark. It's the absence of light, and there's lots of it.

rooms.name: University Square
rooms.description: You are at University Square, a cobblestone-paved crossroads with a large tree in the middle. To the east is the Virtual Campus administrative building entrance. There is a trash can here for keeping the area tidy. North is a path that seems to lead to a small town. The science building is south.

npcs.name: Tim
description: Tim is a student in the Virtual Campus.

npcs.name: Wim
description: Wim is a foreign exchange student from the Netherlands.

scenery.name: building
description: This large building houses the offices of Virtual Campus staff, and is where most business is done. It also contains a snack bar, a small store, and student lounge.

scenery.name: clinic
description: This small clinic is where students in need of medical attention go.

rooms.name: the void
rooms.description:
The void.  Go down to get out.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

rooms.name: Weapons Lab
rooms.description: Weapons are tested here.

rooms.name: Laboratory Wing
rooms.description: This is a bright, shiny laboratory complex connecting to labs where probability experiments are performed. Probability experiments are currently running in the south and southwest labs. The east lab is available for general use. The main hallway of the science building is north.

scenery.name: lab
description: You are in the lab complex. Laboratories can be accessed from here.

scenery.name: stairs
description: Go down to return to the Creators' Hall.
